diagnosis: LOW_YIELD was amplified by lane-head herd contention. A worker in WAVE-20260917-1921-A spent all three bounded authority attempts colliding on the first two role_ready entries and then one recovery entry, while the wave still had additional role_ready capacity. Identical workers were preserving lane priority but starting from the same candidate head.
intervention: Patched the /wc canary and FAST_ALLOCATION_PROTOCOL so explicit batched workers use the already-returned beacon commit SHA to rotate the starting candidate inside a selected lane. Lane priority, atomic create-if-absent ownership, the 3-attempt budget and two-collision lane diversification remain unchanged. Added EFF021, a regression test, and a dedicated GitHub Actions workflow. Concurrent EFF020 capability-routing work was preserved rather than overwritten.

PASS_NO_REGRESSION: lane priority remains ready > queue_ready > role_ready > recovery; max_fast_claim_attempts remains 3; lane diversification remains after 2 same-lane collisions; no extra preclaim read/write is introduced.
